tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and app chrome on ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Wells, KPI tiles and hover fills on surface.

tokens.name: feature
tokens.usage: Dark feature panels: hero cards, device frames, covers. Pair with on-feature.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Surfaces are separated by borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, labels and metadata on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-feature
tokens.usage: Headings and body on feature.

tokens.name: on-feature-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy on feature.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: One primary action per view, the symbol, and lit data. A fill, never text on white or paper.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand dark. Grounds, the wordmark, text. About 60% of any layout.

tokens.name: solar
tokens.usage: Solar Yellow, the one brand color. About 10% of any layout. Ink on solar is 13.1:1; solar on white is 1.5:1, so never text there.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand light ground for pages and documents. About 30% of any layout.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Cards on paper, and the one-color logo on dark grounds.

tokens.name: solar-50
tokens.usage: Tints for highlights and heat maps.

tokens.name: solar-100
tokens.usage: Tints for highlights and heat maps.

tokens.name: solar-200
tokens.usage: Tints for highlights and heat maps.

tokens.name: solar-300
tokens.usage: Tints for highlights and heat maps.

tokens.name: solar-400
tokens.usage: Same as solar.

tokens.name: solar-500
tokens.usage: Shades for heat maps and data on light grounds.

tokens.name: solar-600
tokens.usage: Generation lines and yellow marks on light grounds.

tokens.name: solar-700
tokens.usage: Shades for heat maps and data on light grounds.

tokens.name: solar-800
tokens.usage: Darkest yellow that still reads as yellow; 7.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: solar-900
tokens.usage: Shades for heat maps and data on light grounds.

tokens.name: neutral-0
tokens.usage: White.

tokens.name: neutral-50
tokens.usage: Paper.

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Neutral step.

tokens.name: neutral-200
tokens.usage: Mist.

tokens.name: neutral-300
tokens.usage: Neutral step.

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.usage: Neutral step.

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Neutral step.

tokens.name: neutral-600
tokens.usage: Slate.

tokens.name: neutral-700
tokens.usage: Neutral step.

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.usage: Neutral step.

tokens.name: neutral-900
tokens.usage: Graphite.

tokens.name: neutral-950
tokens.usage: Ink.

tokens.name: status-online
tokens.usage: Online: a filled circle. Always with its shape and a text label; under 3:1 on white, so never the only signal there.

tokens.name: status-degraded
tokens.usage: Degraded, output below target: a triangle. Always with its shape and a text label.

tokens.name: status-fault
tokens.usage: Fault, needs action: a diamond. Always with its shape and a text label.

tokens.name: status-offline
tokens.usage: Offline, no data: a hollow ring. Always with its shape and a text label.

tokens.name: series-generation
tokens.usage: Solar generation in charts. On light grounds draw the line in solar-600 or ink over a solar fill.

tokens.name: series-grid
tokens.usage: Grid import and export in charts.

tokens.name: series-battery
tokens.usage: Battery charge and discharge in charts.

tokens.name: series-load
tokens.usage: Site consumption in charts.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Short labels above headings. Always uppercase, four words at most.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Say what happened, then what to do about it.

styles.name: data-xl
styles.usage: Headline readings. Set the unit at half size in text-muted.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Readings, units and IDs in tables and labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a label or chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between an icon and its text; cell gaps in the array.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between tiles and cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page side margins on wide layouts.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags and small swatches.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards inside a panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels, tiles and hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars and round badges only. Buttons are not pills.

tokens.name: lean
tokens.usage: The brand lean: one across for every three up. skewX(-18.4deg) for chips, meters, tags, array cells and photo crops.
